claim: AWS Global View in the AWS Management Console now offers an interactive map view that plots all AWS Regions and AWS Local Zones, and customers can toggle between it and the existing list view; previously, customers had to scan through a list of AWS locations in Global View.

evidence.quote: Today, AWS announces the addition of an interactive map view to AWS Global View in the AWS Management Console, providing a visual way to explore AWS Global Infrastructure.
Previously, customers had to scan through a list of AWS locations in AWS Global View.
With this new capability, customers can toggle between the interactive map view and the existing list view, making it easier to visualize their global AWS infrastructure footprint.
When customers select the map view, they will see all AWS Regions and AWS Local Zones plotted on an interactive map.
